problems.explain: Order does not matter, so the draws are combinations: 15 × 14 × 13 × 12 ÷ 4! = 1,365, and exactly 1 of them is yours. (Dividing by 32,760, the ordered count, would need your numbers in the drawn order.) So 1/1365.

problems.text: race chance: 10 runners, A first and B second
problems.explain: Gold and silver can go 10 × 9 = 90 ways, and only 1 of them is Ivan then Eli. (Not 2/90: Eli winning gold and Ivan silver is a different result.) So 1/90.

problems.text: row chance: 4 people, A and B together
